h1: AI Unboxing Video Maker: Open the Parcel from One Photo
lead: A product photo can still become an opening shot for the ad. AIVideosUGC builds that unboxing from the photo or the product page.
benefits_h2: What You Gain From an AI Unboxing
benefits_lead: You get the next open without clearing a table for a camera and a free afternoon.

benefits.d: You get the tea tin's lid lift with the sentence already in it, ready to try once that tin is the one you plan to announce.

benefits.t: A Plan Instead of a Shoot Fee
benefits.d: A 15-second open uses 60 credits, and a failed clip returns those credits. The charge appears before each render.

benefits.t: As Many Opens as the Test Needs
benefits.d: Two opens can share one photo of a face oil. One talks about a gift, one talks about the scent. Buy the audience that answers.
By the third week a sneaker open can feel familiar. Change the first sentence, keep the shoe in frame, and replace the tired cut.
A chocolate-bar line can use the name you sell under. You set the words, and the actor does not upgrade them to a fancier label.
On a paid plan the clip can run as an ad. You do not have to ask a creator before the buy starts.

faq.q: What is an AI unboxing video?
faq.a: It shows a mailer opening onto the product you sell, with an actor who can name what is inside. You do not film the table.

faq.q: How do I make an unboxing with AI?
faq.a: Start with a product photo, and say if you want tissue in the shot. Download the open after you approve the sentence the actor will speak.

faq.q: Which page should I use for an unboxing ad?
faq.a: Use this flow when the product should come out of a mailer on camera. A general spoken ad, with no parcel, starts on [UGC video ads](page:video-ads).

faq.q: Do I have to pay to make an unboxing?
faq.a: Yes. Every clip spends credits on a monthly plan. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A 15-second open uses 60 credits, and failed clips return those credits.

faq.q: Can I use the clip in a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. The clip on a paid plan can be the ad you pay to run, and the file has no watermark. Do not present it as a buyer filming a package they received.

faq.q: Which sizes and lengths can I download?
faq.a: Choose a square, a wide 16:9, or a tall 9:16 frame, plus 4:3 and 3:4. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

faq.q: Can I open a whole catalog at once?
faq.a: Yes. Each product can get an open from its own photo. Your shop software can request those jobs through an API.

faq.q: Can an AI unboxing replace a filmed unboxing?
faq.a: A filmed open is the one to keep when someone who received the order can show it. Use the generated open when you still need to see which first line is worth buying.

faq.q: Will TikTok or Meta reject an AI unboxing?
faq.a: Read the ad account's current rule before you fund the open. If a viewer could think a buyer filmed their own package, add the label that account asks for.

definition.title: What Is an AI Unboxing Video?
paras: An AI unboxing video shows a product coming out of its mailer, with an AI actor and a spoken line. You start from a photo you already use, or from the product page, and you skip booking a camera for the table.
A 9:16 cut fits a phone placement, and 1:1 fits a square feed. 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4 are there when the buy asks for them.

more_sections.lead: The same unboxing setup, pointed at the kind of product you sell.

items.d: A jar comes up out of tissue, with a short spoken line about what is in the mailer.
The hero piece appears first, then the extras, with captions on the clip.
The garment comes out of the shipping pack so the shape reads in the first second.
The carton opens and the clip ends on the bottle or the bag you actually sell.
The device and the cable land in one view as the lid comes off.
The parcel opens onto the band or the mat, with an actor from the library on camera.
Box, tissue, and the product share the table, then the file goes to TikTok or Meta.

reviews.h2: How Shops Use an AI Unboxing Video
reviews.lead: How a type of shop might use one open. These are examples, not customer quotes.

items.d: A gift shop uses the unboxing, with a script, an AI actor on camera, and a voice. The parcel and the product both show before checkout.
A beauty shop starts from one jar photo, or from the product link, and gets the unboxing back without booking a creator.
A home shop uploads the product photo, then makes the unboxing from that same picture.
An apparel shop picks an AI actor from the actor library. They trim the unboxing in the editor on the same screen.
A skincare shop makes the same unboxing in a second language when the buyers are not all local.
A pet shop adds on-screen captions and a song from the music library in the editor, then downloads.
An agency picks a different AI actor for each client's unboxing, still from one product photo.
An electronics brand builds an AI actor from a few photos of someone on the team, then uses that face for the unboxing.
A supplement shop pastes the product link. The tool drafts the script, the AI actor, and the voice, including another language.
A marketplace seller tells the video agent how the box should open. The helper drafts the script and the clip.
